title: James McDonnell's search for 'gremlins' in his planes

tellings.quote: He would call them gremlins. And so he spent a lot of his research career looking for ghosts in the machine.

plain: An aviation figure tied to the aircraft maker McDonnell Douglas is said to have spent much of his research career hunting for "gremlins," his word for unexplained faults or presences in his planes. The story's title gives his name as James McDonnell, while Michels's citation gives it as James McDonald. Michels tells it himself, without naming a source, in an episode with the Navy fighter pilot Ryan Graves, describing it as a search for "ghosts in the machine."
